root_idea.summary: A root centered on greatness in size, strength, magnitude, rank, or force, with the concrete image of substantial bone underlying extensions to abstract importance and eminence.
root_idea.development: The lexical field develops from physical largeness and strength to greatness in tangible or intellectual things, comparative superiority, honor and reverence, gravity, and the main or bulk of something.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form.
Displayed as the comparative nominal form.
The supplied QAC group combines adjective عَظِيم with plural noun عِظَام; both lexical branches are retained under a combined display headword.
Displayed under the normalized singular noun citation form.

senses.definition: To magnify, honor, revere, or treat with respect.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive; in the Quranic occurrences, the object is something accorded reverence or esteem.
A transitive causative use; the Quranic occurrence expresses making something great.

senses.definition: Greater, more important, or more significant in comparison with another.
senses.usage_conditions: Comparative or relational; the comparison may concern rank, reward, standing, or degree.

senses.definition: Great, immense, mighty, or exalted; exceptional in size, rank, degree, or standing.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of tangible or abstract things. As an epithet of God, it denotes incomparable greatness and majesty rather than a human comparison.

senses.definition: Grave, momentous, severe, or formidable; involving great weight, seriousness, or consequence.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of affairs, punishments, accusations, sins, calamities, and other matters of great gravity.

senses.definition: Bones; the skeletal bones of the body.
senses.usage_conditions: عِظَام is the plural of عَظْم and is a noun, distinct from the adjective عَظِيم, despite their inclusion in one supplied QAC form group.
A concrete anatomical noun; the Quranic occurrences refer to bodily bone or bones.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become great, large, important, or high in rank; to exceed ordinary size or standing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb, used literally of size and figuratively of estimation or importance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give a dog a bone to eat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive lexical construction with a dog as the recipient in the attested example.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike someone upon the bones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive bodily-action construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of rain, to moisten to the measure of the thick part of the arm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the depth or extent to which rain has penetrated or moistened something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut up a sheep or goat bone by bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive butchery construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become great.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intransitive Form IV use is cross-referenced with the Form I meaning of becoming great.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To frighten, terrify, or distress someone; to make something grievous in its effect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive psychological or experiential construction, with the affected person expressed as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To magnify oneself, act proudly or haughtily, behave insolently, or hold oneself above and disdain something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive Form V use concerning self-regard and disdain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of God, to be incomparable in greatness or majesty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized theological use, not a description of human pride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become so great that nothing is great in comparison with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative construction used of a thing, event, rain, or other subject whose magnitude eclipses comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be of great magnitude, gravity, or difficulty; to become grievous, distressing, or burdensome to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said especially of an affair or event with عَلَيْهِ or a similar affected-person construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To judge, reckon, or regard something as great or important.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive evaluative construction involving an observer’s assessment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take the greater or main part of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive use concerning the greater portion of a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion of a slaughtered camel distributed in the game of maysir.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized cultural term for a portion of the animal used in the reported game.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of an Arab game in which a bone, or white bone, is thrown at night and the party finding it prevails.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed game name and idiom, not a general meaning of anatomical bone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wooden part of a camel saddle, without its leather bands or other gear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression referring to the bare wooden saddle structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The broad board of a plough at the head of which the iron share is fixed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A winnowing-fork.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal variant of عَضْمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The handle or grasped part of a bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal variant of عَضْمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main part, middle, or beaten track of a road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression for the principal or most-used part of a road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Self-magnification, pride, haughtiness, or insolence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Generally blameworthy when attributed to a human being.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A title to honor, respect, or consideration; recognized standing or rights that command regard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A laudatory human use referring to social esteem rather than arrogance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Incomparable greatness or majesty when attributed to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A divine attribute not defined by human comparison or likeness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thick part of the forearm, especially the half nearer the elbow and its principal muscle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thick part of the tongue above its root.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The chiefs or nobles of a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural expression for leading persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who desires large penises.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sexual description explicitly restricted to the attested female subject and desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pigeon tending toward whiteness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective apparently motivated by the whiteness associated with bone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe calamity, misfortune, or great crime.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine noun for a grave event or offense; its plural is used for grave crimes or calamities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pillow, garment, or piece of cloth used by a woman to make her buttocks appear large.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized item of clothing or padding used for bodily enlargement in appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The greater, main, principal, or bulk of a thing, group, affair, or event; sometimes its middle or midst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal form referring to the predominant portion or central part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The harder parts of the body, such as the neck or thigh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily use reported for the term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young weaned camel whose tongue has had a bone broken so that it cannot perform the relevant sucking action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized veterinary or animal-husbandry term.
